messages:
maria: Heads-up — I sketched an RFC for a deploy CLI macro + an 'autogate' prototype. Hoping for quick feedback before I open the PR.

maria: TL;DR: single /deploy macro that can: pin versions, run preflight tests, generate release notes, and optionally enforce a canary pass gate that can auto-rollforward when criteria met.

raj: can you paste the CLI examples? curious how it differs from current deploy-bot commands.

maria: sure — example invocations:

```
# standard deploy (dry-run by default)
/deploy microservice-a --to=prod --version=2025.10.3
\n# pin release and force (explicit)
/deploy microservice-a --to=prod --pin --version=2025.10.3 --force
\n# gated canary: run smoke tests, wait for canary window, auto-rollforward on success
/deploy microservice-a --to=prod --version=2025.10.3 --canary=10m --autogate
\n# generate release notes only
/deploy microservice-a --release-notes > NOTES.md
```

maria: Key behaviors: dry-run by default, --pin separates version pinning from deploy, --autogate evaluates smoke metrics and will only roll to full rollout if canary passes. Auto-rollback is available but off by default.

deploy-bot: [bot] Received command: `/deploy microservice-a --to=prod --version=2025.10.3 --canary=10m --autogate`
deploy-bot: [bot] Preflight checks: image exists, infra quotas ok, migrations dry-run ok.

kevin: love the single entrypoint idea. a couple questions:
 - what metrics does autogate check?
 - how do we handle change windows / blackout periods?

maria: good q. autogate uses our existing canary metrics: error-rate delta, p95 latency, and a tiny synthetic smoke test. thresholds are configurable per service. For change windows, the macro consults the release calendar and will block unless `--override-window` is provided and signed off.

emma: strongly +1 for dry-run default. also suggest adding `--notes-template=team/release_short.md` so ops can choose templates.

maria: added that in the draft — sample notes template below. would generate if you pass --release-notes or when deploy finishes.

```
# release_short.md (template)
- Summary: {{summary}}
- Changes: {{changelist}}
- Rollout plan: Canary {{canary_duration}}, full rollout {{rollout_strategy}}
- Rollback plan: {{rollback_steps}}
- Owners: {{oncall}}
```

raj: nice. can the bot append the PR/commit list automatically? that was a pain point.

maria: yes — we pull commits from the pinned version -> generate changelist, and we can include JIRA/PR links. we also emit a short HTML block for the console.

kevin: operational concerns: auto-rollforward sounds risky for some infra-heavy services. propose two modes: `autogate=monitor` (won't auto progress, just report) and `autogate=auto` (will roll if pass). default to monitor.

maria: agreed, default to monitor. add `--autogate=auto|monitor|off`.

emma: can we add a tiny template for rollback shorthand? `--rollback-on=error-rate>0.5%` or `--auto-rollback=on`?

maria: yes, we support `--auto-rollback` with rule syntax from the evals service. default off. will document examples.

raj: sounds good. what's the implementation plan? PR? timeline?

maria: opening PR today: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821 — proto lives in infra/tools/deploy-macros. plan: land CLI + bot parser (week 1), add autogate evaluator and templates (week 2), service opt-ins (week 3).

kevin: i can take the autogate evaluator integration (contrasts with current evals API). happy to pair with maria on rules syntax.

maria: awesome — assigning you.

emma: i'll add the release-note templates to /templates/releases and update developer docs.

raj: quick ask: add a `--change-window` flag that shows linked calendar slot and who signed it off.

maria: done in draft. bot will show calendar link and `@approver` if present.

deploy-bot: [bot] PR opened: infra/pull/4821 by maria. CI: running.

kevin: :thumbsup: when CI passes i'll review.

maria: thanks all — will iterate on comments. filing a small follow-up doc in docs/releases explaining semantics and opt-in process.

raj: :rocket:

maria: moving to implementer sync on Thurs 10am for handoff.
